newsitem.title: USA: CBOE expects to list 200 new equity options a year.
newsitem.headline: CBOE expects to list 200 new equity options a year.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange expects to list around 200 new equity options a year for the foreseeable future, said Edward Provost, senior vice president of operations planning at the exchange.

At a news conference marking the CBOE's integration of the New York Stock Exchange's former options business, Provost said the CBOE has been adding option classes at a rate of about 200 a year over the last 12 to 18 months.
"As you make your way into additional underlying securities, the quality of the underlying begins to wane, but there are always new opportunities out there," he said.
"Our estimate is that we'll keep on the same pace for some time to come," he said.

Provost said CBOE's agreement with the NYSE requires the CBOE to allocate a minimum of 14 new option classes a year to the relocated New York unit, which consists of roughly 50 traders, eight trading stations and 164 equity options housed in the CBOE's new "Green Room" trading floor.
"We would expect that the Green Room would get substantially more than the 14, but the contract calls for a minimum of 14 new option classes," he said.
